title: HotWax/Chelan Weekly Checkin
summary:
The meeting reviewed feature progress, UAT preparation, production deployment requirements, and order synchronization problems between OFBiz and end-to-end. Most major enhancements were moving into internal QA, with a larger set expected for UAT the following week; production deployment would require resetting production, deploying the changes, and resynchronizing data because of end-to-end data-fetching changes.

The team clarified test-tracking status and requested a consolidated list of testable items and priorities. Synchronization from end-to-end to OFBiz runs every five minutes, while OFBiz-to-end-to-end updates are asynchronous and generally appear within seconds. A fifteen-minute recovery job is intended to resend missed live updates.

A consigned-shipment change made in OFBiz was overwritten because the required consignment-shipment API was not implemented. Similar problems affected non-consignment fields, including potentially unsupported freight-related updates such as FRTTRA. Miryia also reported broader synchronization inconsistencies, while Stan stated that OFBiz-to-end-to-end updates should generally complete within approximately ten seconds.

The team considered unsent-change flags, revision history, stale indicators, order locks, and temporarily blocking reverse updates to prevent conflicting edits. Solomon noted that the Rocket API can return an order-in-use condition and that HotWax locks can be reclaimed under defined circumstances. The behavior of locks, queued audit processing, and synchronization delays remained under discussion.

Mridul confirmed that synchronization defects could cause order details to be overwritten when the base order was not properly synchronized. Development fixes were complete and under testing, including displaying failed end-to-end synchronization errors on the order-detail page and temporarily disabling edits while synchronization is in progress. Questions about permitting edits to shipped orders remained unresolved.
action_items: Patrick Gibbons will update Stan Ruggiero’s document later in the week.
Arpit will email the completed items available for UAT.
Mridul Pathak will prepare the team for production reset, feature deployment, and data resynchronization as the release approaches.
Miryia will email the new issues identified during testing.
Miryia will send the order identifier that failed to synchronize for investigation.
Mridul Pathak will move the synchronization fixes to UAT after testing is complete
Mridul Pathak will send an email with questions about enabling edits for shipped orders
